profile.headline: Full-stack Software Engineer| 2024 SANS Cyber Academy Graduate | Ada Developer Academy Graduate | Trained Data Analyst | Certified Educator
profile.summary: Full stack software developer with cybersecurity training. Passionate about education and creating a more equitable society.  Outstanding relationship-building, communication, and problem-solving skills. Experienced with cross-cultural professional relationships and proficient in Korean.

positions.title: Virtual Networking Software Engineer
positions.description: After completing my 5-month internship, I accepted a full-time offer with my team, where I will continue to contribute to my team's goal of building a placement and orchestrator management plane service for Oracle's Virtual Cloud Network.

positions.title: Virtual Network Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
My team is part of Oracle's OCI Virtual Networking Organization. We are building a placement and orchestrator management plane service for managing Virtual Cloud Network (VCN) resources within Oracle’s cloud infrastructure platform.

So far during  my internship, I have: 

- Designed and implemented command-line tooling in Java (using argparse4j) and shell scripting to streamline bulk operational management of network resources, improving internal team efficiency.

- Enhanced system health monitoring by implementing extensible system-level metric validations (CPU and memory usage), improving observability, and laying the groundwork for future metric integration.

positions.title: Student Software Engineer
positions.description:
Ada Developers Academy is a non-profit organization that provides tuition-free full-stack software development training to women and gender-expansive adults. The 11-month intensive program includes a 5-month internship with one of Ada's corporate partners leaving their students fully prepared to launch their new careers in software development.

Project Highlights:
-ChoreChamp: a full-stack web application that motivates users as they track and manage household chores. As the team project manager, I cultivated the project’s vision and organized project tasks to ensure features aligned with the project goals, trimming features that were out of scope. As lead backend engineer, I managed the design and creation of our multi-relational database, guiding several rounds of refactoring to produce a schema that best matched our needs.
Utilizes: Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, React, React Router, Heroku, Netlify

-It's a Mood, Digital Mood Board: a full-stack web application where users can curate collections of inspirational text. As team project manager, I tracked project tasks,  coordinated team members' work, and ensured the final application was aligned with project requirements. I created a set of backend unit tests that provided 100% code coverage as well as a front-end utility module that greatly reduced code duplication and increased code adherence to S.O.L.I.D principles.
Utilizes: Flask, SqlAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Python, Pytest, ReactJS, Material UI, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Render
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Python (Programming Language) · Flask · PostgreSQL · Project Planning

positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · SQL · Data Analysis

positions.title: English Language Instructor
positions.description:
-Create and teach English education curricula for Seoul elementary school teachers.
- Provide special training on teaching elementary English for current elementary English teachers.
- Proofread and edit English context for national English examinations.
- Design and run bi-annual intensive English camps for students without native English instructors.
positions.insights: Skills: Teaching English as a Foreign Language · Curriculum Development · Project Management · Intercultural Communication

positions.title: Native English Instructor
positions.description:
-Coordinated and consulted with Korean teachers to create a uniform learning plan for 3rd, 4th, 5th, and 6th-grade students.
- Prepared and taught daily English lessons for 20 classes of 20-25 students from grades 3rd to 6th.
- Proofread and edited all supplementary English materials and exams for all grades.
-Annually researched, designed and led 5 weeks of English camp and increased application rates more than three-fold.

positions.title: Fulbright English Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
English Teaching Assistant at Seoul Huam Elementary School
•	Prepared and taught daily English lessons to class of 20-25 students from grades 4th to 6th.
•	Planned and lead an after-school English club for a group of 12 unprivileged students.
•	Designed and led two one-week long 4 hours a day English Winter camps for 24 students.
English Teaching Assistant at Daejeon Technical High School
•	Prepared and taught two English lessons bi-weekly to classes of 15-30 students.
•	Edited and recorded an English textbook created specifically for technical high school students.
•	Designed and led two one-week long 4 hours a day English Winter camps for 20 students.
•	Co-lead an after school tri-weekly English club class for ten students.

positions.title: Corps Member
positions.description:
- Tutored 10 seventh graders in a  one-on-one seting in math during the school every day to raise bi-weekly assessment scores from below basic to proficient.

-Leaded an average of 89 students in an online math curriculum in a daily after school program to engage students in extra math instruction.

-Designed and implemented  two 6-week enrichment curricula , one focusing on  science and the other focusing on drama.

-Directed 2 one-day long service projects, supervising 30 volunteers in manual labor in their local communities.

positions.title: Youth University Summer Program Leader
positions.description:
•	Supported in planning, directing and supervising departmental lectures, campus tours, and academic activities for Youth University
•	Delivered a highly interactive writing curriculum to 80 middle school students that promoted higher education, personal goals, academic skills, and leadership development.
•	Built relationships with the children and helped them to learn and demonstrate the YMCA core values.

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description:
- Provided academic assistance to 1-3 clients (ranging from 3 graders to adults taking part-time classes) per week for 1-2 hours a week each

-Designed a tutoring protocol specific to each client, allowing them to improve their academic performance

-Gained valuable teaching experience

positions.title: Physician Scientist Training Program SURF Intern
positions.description:
- Spent 4 hours a week shadowing a neuro-oncologist

- Successfully utilized a mouse model to examine the efficacy of a recombinant plasmid

- Design and present a poster on my research

positions.title: Cell Line Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Successfully constructed recombinant plasmid DNA for several IgGs. 

-Became proficient in PCR, gel electrophoresis, cloning, eletroporation, and other molecular lab techniques.

-Created scientific posters and presentations.

-Learned how to effectively work in a team-oriented setting.

positions.title: Environmental Coordinator for the Oncology Department
positions.description:
- Inventoried medical supplies in 12-16 patients’ rooms every day.

- Ordered and restocked all missing items as well as emergency supplies for general floor use.

- Aided nurses with patient care and assisted patients’ visitors.
